Dina: Heads-up: we're preparing a micro A/B price experiment (variant Y) targeting a partner cohort tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need finance + vendor-legal ack before we flip.
Marco: What's the scope? invoice visibility?
Dina: Scope = 30 partner accounts. Shadow invoices only for the first run. Live invoices unchanged. Shadow will include both old/new line-items.
Priyanka: Grandfathering rules? credits?
Dina: Grandfathering cutoff = created before 2024-12-01. Protected accounts keep current pricing for 30 days after promotion; promo credits honored until expiry.
Marco: Canary caps? We should set a global spend cap and per-account throttle.
Dina: Canary=30, per-account cap=250k tokens/day, global cap=$2k/day. Auto-rollback if spend delta >18% or >2 vendor errors.
VendorLegal: Vendor ok with non-billable shadow run; requested a 1-paragraph attestation and rollback clause.
BillingBot: [system] shadow_run queued for 2026-03-08T19:00:00Z (id: sh_2223).
Priyanka: I'll run diff CSV: acct, sku, baseline_unit, variant_unit, baseline_total, variant_total, delta_pct. Will flag >20% deltas.
FinanceOps: Approvals must be added to the experiment doc. Tag @finance-approvals when done; no promotion without all signoffs.
Dina: Plan recap: shadow run then diff, vendor memo + 3 approvals, monitoring & caps in place. Proceeding once approvals land.
Marco: :thumbsup: I'll monitor billing alerts and watch for anomalies.
BillingBot: [system] sh_2223 started at 2026-03-08T19:00:05Z
Priyanka: Shadow diffs uploaded -> avg delta +6.5%, 2 accounts >20% flagged. Uploading CSV now.
Dina: Reviewing flagged accounts and will update the doc. Thanks everyone.
